description: Secure local collection, file indexing, action extraction, and schedule storage helpers

components.agent_wrapper.py: Fail-closed collection pipeline: authenticated Browser daemon with global request interception, then secure Fetch MCP fallback
components.action_extractor.py: Model-assisted action extraction with schedule persistence

optional: browser-use only through the explicit reduced-security override

backend_policy.dynamic_primary: authenticated Browser daemon; visible DOM text with bounded lazy-load scrolling and optional screenshot/Vision enrichment
backend_policy.static_fallback: secure_fetch_mcp with DNS/IP validation, redirect revalidation, and response-size limits
backend_policy.browser_use: disabled by default because Agent Forge cannot yet inject the shared network policy into all browser-use requests; AGENT_FORGE_ALLOW_UNGUARDED_BROWSER_USE=1 is an explicit reduced-security override

limitations: daemon collection requires the Browser daemon to be started separately until the runtime supervisor is implemented
generated Markdown reports are confined to ignored _runtime or OS temporary storage
browser-use results are marked degraded_security when the operator explicitly enables that backend
